stem.en: Last week Dilnoza ___ a new jacket at the market.

why.en: Buy is an irregular verb: its past simple is bought.
why.uz: Buy — irregular feʼl: uning Past Simple shakli bought.
why.ru: Buy — неправильный глагол: его форма Past Simple — bought.

stem.en: We ___ to the mountains last weekend.

why.en: The past simple of go is went; gone needs have before it.
why.uz: Go ning Past Simple shakli went; gone dan oldin have kerak boʻladi.
why.ru: Past Simple от go — went; перед gone нужен have.

stem.en: I ___ a strange noise in the night and woke up.

why.en: Hear is irregular: hear → heard. The other verb (woke) is past too.
why.uz: Hear — irregular feʼl: hear → heard. Gapdagi ikkinchi feʼl (woke) ham oʻtgan zamonda.
why.ru: Hear — неправильный глагол: hear → heard. Второй глагол (woke) тоже в прошедшем.

options.en: He wrote to his friend yesterday.
He writed to his friend yesterday.
He written to his friend yesterday.
He write to his friend yesterday.

why.en: Write is irregular: the past simple is wrote; written is the past participle.
why.uz: Write — irregular feʼl: Past Simple shakli wrote; written esa uchinchi shakl (past participle).
why.ru: Write — неправильный глагол: Past Simple — wrote; written — третья форма (причастие).

stem.en: ___ you see Bekzod at the party on Saturday?

why.en: A past simple question uses Did + the base verb: Did you see...?
why.uz: Past Simple soʻroq gapi Did + feʼlning asosiy shakli bilan tuziladi: Did you see...?
why.ru: Вопрос в Past Simple: Did + начальная форма глагола: Did you see...?

stem.en: The museum ___ open on Monday, so we went on Tuesday.

why.en: Open here is an adjective after be; the past negative of is is wasn't.
why.uz: Bu yerda open — be dan keyingi sifat; is ning oʻtgan zamondagi inkori wasn't.
why.ru: Здесь open — прилагательное после be; прошедшее отрицание от is — wasn't.

stem.en: Where ___ you go on holiday last year?

why.en: Last year is past, and go is a main verb, so the question needs did: Where did you go?
why.uz: Last year oʻtgan vaqt, go esa asosiy feʼl, shuning uchun savolga did kerak: Where did you go?
why.ru: Last year — прошлое, go — смысловой глагол, поэтому нужен did: Where did you go?

stem.en: My brother ___ breakfast this morning because he was late.

why.en: After didn't, use the base verb: didn't have, not didn't had.

why.ru: После didn't нужна начальная форма: didn't have, а не didn't had.

stem.en: At eight o'clock last night I ___ my homework.

why.en: An action in progress at a past moment: was/were + -ing; with I it is was doing.
why.uz: Oʻtmishdagi aniq paytda davom etgan harakat: was/were + -ing; I bilan was doing.
why.ru: Действие в процессе в момент прошлого: was/were + -ing; с I — was doing.

stem.en: The children ___ in the garden when it started to rain.

why.en: Children is plural, so the past continuous is were + -ing: were playing.
why.uz: Children koʻplikda, shuning uchun Past Continuous were + -ing: were playing.
why.ru: Children — множественное число, поэтому Past Continuous: were + -ing: were playing.

why.ru: Doing указывает на Past Continuous; с you используется were: What were you doing?

why.ru: Два действия, длившихся одновременно в прошлом: оба в форме was + -ing.

stem.en: This test is ___ than the last one.

why.en: Short adjectives ending in -y change y to i and add -er: easy → easier than.
why.uz: -y bilan tugaydigan qisqa sifatlarda y i ga oʻzgaradi va -er qoʻshiladi: easy → easier than.
why.ru: У коротких прилагательных на -y буква y меняется на i и добавляется -er: easy → easier than.

stem.en: This is the ___ day of the year so far.

why.en: The + superlative: hot doubles the t and adds -est: the hottest.
why.uz: The + orttirma daraja: hot da t ikkilanadi va -est qoʻshiladi: the hottest.
why.ru: The + превосходная степень: в hot удваивается t и добавляется -est: the hottest.

stem.en: My new phone is ___ than my old one.

why.en: Long adjectives use more + adjective in comparisons with than: more expensive.
why.uz: Uzun sifatlar than bilan solishtirishda more + sifat shaklida keladi: more expensive.
why.ru: Длинные прилагательные при сравнении с than: more + прилагательное: more expensive.
